responsibility: Declares the StrIO interface for simple string-based input and output over the current StdIO streams, exporting line output, interactive string reading, and plain string writing. It is the high-level text I/O header above generic character dispatch and below numeric conversion routines that read or print through strings.
same_name_distinction: This header differs from GStrIO.cc by declaring the high-level string I/O routines only. It does not include the internal echo state, editing helpers, or the character-by-character line input and output logic implemented in the .cc file.
